```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import glob
from pathlib import Path

RESULTS = Path("../..") / "results"
```

## Setup

Two synthetic datasets generated with known ground truth K:

- **K=1 GT**: SBM (n=200, ε=0.85), single kernel (β=0.05), iid assignment
- **K=2 GT**: SBM (n=200, ε=0.85), two kernels (β=0.02 / β=0.10), block_flip assignment (ω=0)


```{python}
SWEEPS = {
    "K=1 ground truth\n(single kernel, β=0.05)": (
        "cv_model_sel_k1_gt_20260501", "cv_k1_ground_truth", 1
    ),
    "K=2 ground truth\n(two-block SBM, β=0.02/0.10)": (
        "cv_model_sel_k2_gt_20260501", "cv_k2_ground_truth", 2
    ),
}

def load_cv_results(sweep_name, dataset_name):
    rows = []
    base = RESULTS / sweep_name / "synthetic" / dataset_name
    for p in sorted(base.glob("K~*/cv_summary.parquet")):
        df = pd.read_parquet(p)
        row = df.iloc[0].to_dict()
        row["K"] = int(p.parent.name.split("~")[1])
        rows.append(row)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("K").reset_index(drop=True)

results = {label: load_cv_results(sweep, dset) for label, (sweep, dset, _) in SWEEPS.items()}
```

## Kernel recovery — all K fits

```{python}
def sc_kernel(beta, nu_max):
    nu = np.arange(1, nu_max + 1)
    return nu, 1 - (1 - beta) ** nu

def select_best_fold(sweep, dataset, k_fit, nu_max=15):
    """Return kernel_mode_summary from the fold with maximum component separation."""
    pattern = f"../../results/{sweep}/synthetic/{dataset}/K~{k_fit}/cv_fold~*/kernel_mode_summary.parquet"
    best_path, best_spread = None, -1
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
        df = pd.read_parquet(p)
        nu1 = df[df.nu == 1].groupby("component")["median"].mean()
        spread = nu1.max() - nu1.min() if len(nu1) > 1 else 0
        if spread > best_spread:
            best_spread, best_path = spread, p
    if best_path is None:
        return None
    df = pd.read_parquet(best_path)
    return df[df.nu <= nu_max].copy()
```

```{python}
COMP_COLORS = ["#2196F3", "#E91E63", "#FF9800", "#4CAF50"]
NU_MAX = 15

GT_INFO = {
    "cv_k1_ground_truth": {
        "sweep": "cv_model_sel_k1_gt_20260501",
        "betas": [0.05],
        "row_label": "K=1 GT  (β=0.05)",
        "true_colors": ["black"],
    },
    "cv_k2_ground_truth": {
        "sweep": "cv_model_sel_k2_gt_20260501",
        "betas": [0.02, 0.10],
        "row_label": "K=2 GT  (β=0.02 / 0.10)",
        "true_colors": ["#1B5E20", "#B71C1C"],
    },
}
K_FITS = [1, 2, 3, 4]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 4, figsize=(16, 7), sharey=False)

for row_idx, (dset, info) in enumerate(GT_INFO.items()):
    for col_idx, k_fit in enumerate(K_FITS):
        ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]

        # ground truth kernels
        for beta, tc in zip(info["betas"], info["true_colors"]):
            ax.plot(*sc_kernel(beta, NU_MAX), color=tc, lw=2, ls="--", zorder=4,
                    label=f"True β={beta}" if col_idx == 0 else None)

        # reconstructed components (sorted by nu=1 median for consistent ordering)
        df = select_best_fold(info["sweep"], dset, k_fit, NU_MAX)
        if df is not None:
            order = df[df.nu == 1].sort_values("median")["component"].tolist()
            for rank, comp_id in enumerate(order):
                cdf = df[df.component == comp_id].sort_values("nu")
                color = COMP_COLORS[rank % len(COMP_COLORS)]
                ax.plot(cdf.nu, cdf["median"], color=color, lw=1.8, marker="o", ms=3.5, zorder=3,
                        label=f"Fit comp {rank+1}" if col_idx == 0 else None)
                ax.fill_between(cdf.nu, cdf.ci_low, cdf.ci_high, color=color, alpha=0.12)

        ax.set_title(f"Fit K={k_fit}", fontsize=10)
        ax.set_xticks([1, 5, 10, 15])
        ax.set_xlim(0.5, NU_MAX + 0.5)
        ax.set_ylim(0, None)
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linestyle=":")
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        if col_idx == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel(info["row_label"] + "\nP(infect | ν)", fontsize=9)
            ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper left")
        if row_idx == 1:
            ax.set_xlabel("ν (infected neighbours)", fontsize=10)

fig.suptitle(
    "Kernel recovery · all K fits · best CV fold · posterior median ± 90% CI",
    fontsize=12, y=1.02,
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

**K=1 GT (top row):**: 

We recover the strucure well for one component. 

**K=2 GT (bottom row):** 

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5), sharey=False)

palette = ["#2196F3", "#E91E63"]
markers = ["o", "s"]

for ax, (label, df), (_, __, true_k), color, marker in zip(
    axes,
    results.items(),
    SWEEPS.values(),
    palette,
    markers,
):
    ax.plot(
        df["K"], df["mean_cv_lppd_per_node"],
        color=color, marker=marker, ms=9, lw=2.2, zorder=3,
    )

    # shade under curve
    ax.fill_between(df["K"], df["mean_cv_lppd_per_node"],
                    df["mean_cv_lppd_per_node"].min() - 0.5,
                    alpha=0.07, color=color)

    # mark ground truth K
    gt_y = df.loc[df["K"] == true_k, "mean_cv_lppd_per_node"].values[0]
    ax.axvline(true_k, color="black", lw=1.5, ls="--", alpha=0.5, zorder=2)
    ax.annotate(
        f" K={true_k} (true)",
        xy=(true_k, gt_y),
        xytext=(true_k + 0.15, gt_y + 0.05 * abs(gt_y) * 0.05),
        fontsize=9, color="black", alpha=0.7,
    )

    # annotate deltas
    deltas = df["mean_cv_lppd_per_node"].diff().dropna()
    for k_idx, delta in zip(df["K"].iloc[1:], deltas):
        sign = "+" if delta >= 0 else ""
        ax.annotate(
            f"{sign}{delta:.3f}",
            xy=(k_idx, df.loc[df["K"] == k_idx, "mean_cv_lppd_per_node"].values[0]),
            xytext=(k_idx, df.loc[df["K"] == k_idx, "mean_cv_lppd_per_node"].values[0] + 0.3),
            fontsize=7.5, ha="center", color=color, alpha=0.8,
        )

    ax.set_xlabel("K (mixture components)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean CV lppd per node", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title(label, fontsize=11, pad=10)
    ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 3, 4])
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25, linestyle=":")
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle(
    "CV-based K selection · non_parametric_monotonic · n=200 nodes · 3-fold CV",
    fontsize=12, y=1.01,
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
